      "code": "\n# One-way ANOVA sample size calculation\n# Given: k=3 groups, eta-squared = 0.06, alpha = 0.05, target power = 0.8\n\n# Install and load pwr package if needed\nif (!requireNamespace(\"pwr\", quietly = TRUE)) {\n  install.packages(\"pwr\")\n}\nlibrary(pwr)\n\n# Parameters\nk <- 3                    # Number of groups\neta_squared <- 0.06       # Population effect size (eta-squared)\nalpha <- 0.05             # Significance level\ntarget_power <- 0.8       # Target power\n\n# Convert eta-squared to Cohen's f\n# Cohen's f = sqrt(eta_squared / (1 - eta_squared))\ncohen_f <- sqrt(eta_squared / (1 - eta_squared))\ncat(\"Cohen's f effect size:\", cohen_f, \"\\n\")\n\n# Use pwr.anova.test to find sample size per group\n# pwr.anova.test(k, n, f, sig.level, power)\n# We set n = NULL to solve for sample size\n\nresult <- pwr.anova.test(\n  k = k,\n  n = NULL,\n  f = cohen_f,\n  sig.level = alpha,\n  power = target_power\n)\n\ncat(\"\\nPower analysis result:\\n\")\nprint(result)\n\n# Extract the sample size per group\nn_per_group_continuous <- result$n\ncat(\"\\nSample size per group (continuous):\", n_per_group_continuous, \"\\n\")\n\n# Round up to next integer\nn_per_group <- ceiling(n_per_group_continuous)\ncat(\"Sample size per group (rounded up to integer):\", n_per_group, \"\\n\")\n\n# Verify the power at the rounded sample size\npower_at_rounded <- pwr.anova.test(\n  k = k,\n  n = n_per_group,\n  f = cohen_f,\n  sig.level = alpha,\n  power = NULL\n)\n\ncat(\"\\nVerification - Power at n =\", n_per_group, \":\", power_at_rounded$power, \"\\n\")\n\n# Also check power at n-1 to confirm we chose the minimum\nn_preceding <- n_per_group - 1\npower_at_preceding <- pwr.anova.test(\n  k = k,\n  n = n_preceding,\n  f = cohen_f,\n  sig.level = alpha,\n  power = NULL\n)\n\ncat(\"Power at n =\", n_preceding, \":\", power_at_preceding$power, \"\\n\")\n\n# Summary output\ncat(\"\\n========== SUMMARY ==========\\n\")\ncat(\"Minimum sample size per group:\", n_per_group, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Achieved power at n =\", n_per_group, \":\", power_at_rounded$power, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Power at preceding design (n =\", n_preceding, \"):\", power_at_preceding$power, \"\\n\")\n\n# Prepare JSON output\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=jsonlite::toJSON(\n  list(\n    results = list(\n      list(\n        metric = \"sample_size\",\n        value = n_per_group,\n        unit = \"participants_per_group\"\n      ),\n      list(\n        metric = \"achieved_power\",\n        value = round(power_at_rounded$power, 15),\n        unit = \"probability\"\n      ),\n      list(\n        metric = \"power_at_preceding_design\",\n        value = round(power_at_preceding$power, 15),\n        unit = \"probability\"\n      ),\n      list(\n        metric = \"cohens_f_effect_size\",\n        value = round(cohen_f, 15),\n        unit = \"effect_size\"\n      ),\n      list(\n        metric = \"eta_squared\",\n        value = eta_squared,\n        unit = \"effect_size\"\n      )\n    )\n  ),\n  auto_unbox = TRUE,\n  digits = 15\n)\n\ncat(\"\\n\", POWER_AGENT_RESULT, \"\\n\")\n",

  "fullCode": "# Evidence e1; success=true\n\n# One-way ANOVA sample size calculation\n# Given: k=3 groups, eta-squared = 0.06, alpha = 0.05, target power = 0.8\n\n# Install and load pwr package if needed\nif (!requireNamespace(\"pwr\", quietly = TRUE)) {\n  install.packages(\"pwr\")\n}\nlibrary(pwr)\n\n# Parameters\nk <- 3                    # Number of groups\neta_squared <- 0.06       # Population effect size (eta-squared)\nalpha <- 0.05             # Significance level\ntarget_power <- 0.8       # Target power\n\n# Convert eta-squared to Cohen's f\n# Cohen's f = sqrt(eta_squared / (1 - eta_squared))\ncohen_f <- sqrt(eta_squared / (1 - eta_squared))\ncat(\"Cohen's f effect size:\", cohen_f, \"\\n\")\n\n# Use pwr.anova.test to find sample size per group\n# pwr.anova.test(k, n, f, sig.level, power)\n# We set n = NULL to solve for sample size\n\nresult <- pwr.anova.test(\n  k = k,\n  n = NULL,\n  f = cohen_f,\n  sig.level = alpha,\n  power = target_power\n)\n\ncat(\"\\nPower analysis result:\\n\")\nprint(result)\n\n# Extract the sample size per group\nn_per_group_continuous <- result$n\ncat(\"\\nSample size per group (continuous):\", n_per_group_continuous, \"\\n\")\n\n# Round up to next integer\nn_per_group <- ceiling(n_per_group_continuous)\ncat(\"Sample size per group (rounded up to integer):\", n_per_group, \"\\n\")\n\n# Verify the power at the rounded sample size\npower_at_rounded <- pwr.anova.test(\n  k = k,\n  n = n_per_group,\n  f = cohen_f,\n  sig.level = alpha,\n  power = NULL\n)\n\ncat(\"\\nVerification - Power at n =\", n_per_group, \":\", power_at_rounded$power, \"\\n\")\n\n# Also check power at n-1 to confirm we chose the minimum\nn_preceding <- n_per_group - 1\npower_at_preceding <- pwr.anova.test(\n  k = k,\n  n = n_preceding,\n  f = cohen_f,\n  sig.level = alpha,\n  power = NULL\n)\n\ncat(\"Power at n =\", n_preceding, \":\", power_at_preceding$power, \"\\n\")\n\n# Summary output\ncat(\"\\n========== SUMMARY ==========\\n\")\ncat(\"Minimum sample size per group:\", n_per_group, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Achieved power at n =\", n_per_group, \":\", power_at_rounded$power, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Power at preceding design (n =\", n_preceding, \"):\", power_at_preceding$power, \"\\n\")\n\n# Prepare JSON output\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=jsonlite::toJSON(\n  list(\n    results = list(\n      list(\n        metric = \"sample_size\",\n        value = n_per_group,\n        unit = \"participants_per_group\"\n      ),\n      list(\n        metric = \"achieved_power\",\n        value = round(power_at_rounded$power, 15),\n        unit = \"probability\"\n      ),\n      list(\n        metric = \"power_at_preceding_design\",\n        value = round(power_at_preceding$power, 15),\n        unit = \"probability\"\n      ),\n      list(\n        metric = \"cohens_f_effect_size\",\n        value = round(cohen_f, 15),\n        unit = \"effect_size\"\n      ),\n      list(\n        metric = \"eta_squared\",\n        value = eta_squared,\n        unit = \"effect_size\"\n      )\n    )\n  ),\n  auto_unbox = TRUE,\n  digits = 15\n)\n\ncat(\"\\n\", POWER_AGENT_RESULT, \"\\n\")\n",
